thread:
marco_sales: Quick sync  Prospect FinEdge needs BYO-KMS for PII workload. Requirements they listed: dual-custody KEK, monthly rotations, legal attestation, and pricing delta for HSM egress vs platform-managed keys. Who can lead the POC?

anya_se: I can. Need to confirm network reachability to their CloudHSM endpoints (IPs/ports), whether they require FIPS 140-2/3 attestations, and whether dual-custody means split-threshold or two independent KEK holders.

lina_eng: Heads up: calling customer HSM per token adds ~40-70ms p99 depending on region. Options: local key-proxy with short-lived wrapping tokens (adds infra + audit scope) or do HSM calls only for rotation events and use platform wrapping for hot paths. Need QPS to model cost/latency.

david_security: For legal: we need HSM vendor + FIPS level, attestation format (raw manifests vs vendor-signed statement), rotation proof, and audit log retention SLA (we normally offer 90 days). Also answer: key exportable? No. KMIP support? Optional per customer. BYO model: we either call their HSM on-demand or perform wrapping with a customer KEK via a wrapped key proxy.

marco_sales: Pricing question: do we do one-off setup + per-request HSM egress fees, or fold into Dedicated reserved pricing? Customer asked for both numbers.

anya_se: Typical: one-time SOW for onboarding/attestation/runbook, then two choices: (A) hosted: HSM egress billed per-request; (B) Dedicated: include in reserved fee if they commit. We can produce a delta table.

lina_eng: Concrete tradeoffs: proxy wrapping avoids per-request egress but needs CPU/memory and expands our audit surface. If we only hit HSM at monthly rotation, token gen path cost is low and latency improves. Provide expected QPS and we can simulate.

marco_sales: Action items: 1) get customer HSM IPs/ports and attestation requirements, 2) legal list of attestation fields, 3) expected QPS and rotation cadence. Ops, please open POC ticket.

ops_bot: Ticket created: POC-1609 "FinEdge BYO-KMS POC - network + attestation" assigned to @anya_se. ETA draft runbook by 2025-03-18. https://redwood.example.com/t/POC-1609

david_security: Clarify dual-custody before test vectors: split-threshold keys require a different runbook than two-person approval. Also need to confirm whether fallback to platform KEK is acceptable in an outage - legal must opt-in.

anya_se: Suggested POC test vectors:
```
1) Customer provides wrapping KEK alias in HSM
2) We do a wrap->unwrap test with sample payload and verify both audit logs
3) Simulate monthly rotation and test application failover to platform KEK for 30min window
4) Measure p99 latency for token gen with and without proxy
```

marco_sales: I'll ask FinEdge for those test vectors, the QPS numbers, and legal's attestation spec. Final Q: SLA on rotation incidents?

lina_eng: Proposed: 4hr incident response for rotation failures under enterprise SOW, on-call handoff + escalation to infra. Mitigation: automatic fallback to platform KEK (read-only) during recovery; must be written into SOW with customer consent.

david_security: Add opt-in checkbox for fallback in SOW and require customer sign-off on audit sharing.

marco_sales: Great. I'll get back after sync with FinEdge legal. Thanks team :thumbsup:
